property_summary: For any actor and any deposit, a single withdrawAll call must succeed and fully settle without reentrancy problems; in the buggy version the credit reset after the external call lets a re-entrant withdrawAll attempt underflow `balance` and revert, so the outer withdrawAll fails.
change_summary: Move the credit reset to after the external call, opening a reentrancy window where credit is still nonzero during the call.
